physical_subject: Can a pitch remain when its matching spectral component is absent?
relationship: A mixture of 440, 660 and 880 Hz repeats at 220 Hz despite lacking a 220 Hz component, and can evoke a missing-fundamental pitch.
operation: Remove the first of four components while preserving a waveform period; compare adjacent synthesized mixtures and distinguish physical frequencies from perceived pitch.
closest_prior: old Fourier makes music title; objects/01-beats
substantive_difference: Central operation removes a spectral fundamental while preserving period and separates perception from component presence; not generic Fourier construction or nearby-frequency beating. Earlier Fourier transcript unavailable.
